title: Pg HBA Concepts
summary: The authentication file is ordered policy. A local line is Unix socket access, host is TCP without requiring TLS, and hostssl is TCP that must use TLS. The pg_hba_file_rules view is operational evidence because it shows parsed line numbers, errors, address ranges, databases, users, and methods.
learning_objectives: Explain the operational purpose of Pg HBA Concepts.
Collect PostgreSQL evidence before proposing remediation.
Describe verification and rollback for the administrative action.
reflection_prompts: What evidence would you attach to an incident review?
Which part of the remediation has the largest operational blast radius?
